source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB counterpart defines standard App 0x06/0x4E capability read.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic pre-step requests configuration verification and log clearing.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED pending channel/payload schema and support matrix.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart classifies standard 0x4E read as FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes scope/reference Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Inventory the payload types supported by one approved BMC channel without enabling, authorizing or activating them.
original_method: Issue standard App 0x06/0x4E through a protected transport, validate the channel selector and decode the complete support bitmap against the Project matrix.
manual_activity: Engineer supplies the approved channel and expected support matrix; bounded read requires no action confirmation.
safety_requirements: Do not equate supported with enabled or authorized

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Too conservative after the standard OOB command history is considered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw App 0x06/0x4E or equivalent read-only API with pinned bitmap parser.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read one channel's support bitmap, validate every returned field, distinguish supported from enabled/authorized, compare the approved matrix and prove no payload/session/access mutation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds bounded standard read guidance without Master edits.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only the selected channel and advertised capability are covered; actual payload operation is separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Misinterpreting capability as permission can cause unsafe downstream activation.

project_override_considerations: Vendor API is acceptable only with equivalent payload-type bitmap and semantic distinction from enabled/authorized state.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master is TBD and requests log clearing; GPT V2 makes missing Project schema/matrix a permanent block although the standard 0x4E OOB history resolves the read operation.

blocked_analysis.analysis: 0x4E defines the core read; channel, parser and expected matrix are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Separates payload capability from enablement, authorization and runtime state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The operation is a deterministic, non-mutating channel capability query. With a pinned parser and reference matrix it is safely automatable; no functional setter or activation is needed to satisfy this intent.
